# GTAVITIPS

> GTA 6 database and intel hub. Characters, vehicles, locations, weapons, factions, brands, animals, and activities across Leonida, sourced exclusively from official Rockstar Games communications (trailers, Rockstar Newswire, Take-Two investor posts). Every claim is labeled Confirmed, Reported, or Speculation. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.

Key facts (updated July 2026):
- GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. No PC version announced.
- Pre-orders opened June 25, 2026. Standard Edition $79.99, Ultimate Edition $99.99 (digital only).
- Pre-order bonus: Vintage Vice City Pack, included with both editions.
- Two official trailers released (December 2023, May 2025). Trailer 3 not announced.
- Protagonists: Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval. Setting: state of Leonida, main city Vice City.
